scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project backend uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && uv run --project backend ruff check backend tests/backend && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend tests/backend
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project backend ruff check --fix backend tests/backend && uv run --project backend ruff format backend tests/backend
scripts.test: pnpm --filter frontend test && uv run --project backend pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml tests/backend && pnpm run openapi:check
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
